headline: Approved prior meeting minutes; heard updates on clubhouse opening January 1 and course closing November 22.
summary: Staff reported on sales and an upcoming Turkey Shoot with 58 players. The clubhouse is set to open January 1, and the course closes for the season November 22. Emergency repairs are underway on the Beaver Meadow Brook culvert, which feeds water to the course.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the 9/17/2026 meeting by unanimous voice vote.

plain_text:
MINUTES
Beaver Meadow Golf Advisory Committee Meeting
November 12, 2026
In Attendance: Chris Mulleavey, Jennifer Kretovic, Nathan Fennessy, Steve Norton, Bob 
Whatmough, Judith Fairclough, Charlie Randall, Craig Savage, Jim Tanner, Jerise Mares, Tom 
Aspell, Pat Lanman, and Josh Lacasse.
Excused: Gary Darby, Roger Jobin and Mack Bean.
1) Approval of Meeting Minutes: A motion was made and seconded to approve the minutes 
from the 9/17/2026 meeting. The minutes were approved with a unanimous voice vote.
2) Pro Shop Update:
 Pat Lanman and Josh Lacasse provided year over year comparisons of sales, rounds and 
Pro Shop revenue.
 Staff are preparing for the upcoming Turkey Shoot tournament being held on Saturday, 
11/14. A total of 58 individuals will be playing in the tournament.
 The winter simulator league is expected to start on the first Monday in January.
3) Course Update:
 Leaf clean-up is underway and the irrigation system is being blown out.
 The course will close for the season on Sunday, November 22nd.
 Pat indicated that the clubhouse project is running on time. He is hoping to start moving 
into the new building the first week of December and officially opening the clubhouse on
January 1st. As soon as everything is out of the current clubhouse, demolition of that 
building will begin.
4) CIP Review:
 Pat provided an overview of the golf course’s proposed CIP projects for FY 2028 and the 
outyears.
5) New Business:
 Jennifer Kretovic noted that emergency repairs are being made to the Beaver Meadow 
Brook culvert, which has been failing and directly feeds water to the golf course.
 Steve Norton provided an update on Ski the Beav’ activities and noted that they are 
looking for direction as to where at the golf course they can place their ski trailer for the 
winter. He noted that Friends of the Beav are also looking to host some sort of a 
celebration for the new clubhouse.
6) 5 Minutes of Public Input:
 Concord resident Stacey Brown asked for information about rainchecks, as well as how 
much usage resulted from the 400 rounds that were given out. Pat did not have the 
information at this time. She asked if there will be wifi at the new clubhouse, to which 
Pat indicated yes. She suggested the course offer a designated place for sledding. Steve 
Norton said he would look into it with the Ski the Beav’ group.
7) Adjournment: A motion was made and seconded, and the meeting was adjourned at 8:58
AM with a unanimous voice vote.
